en.name: Fresh coconut cream
en.summary: Freshly pressed coconut cream is grated coconut flesh squeezed with a little water — a raw, unpasteurised emulsion, much closer to raw milk than to the tin. Get it cold and use it within 1–2 days, or freeze it for about 3 months.
en.pantry: It cannot sit out. A fresh press is a low-acid, protein- and fat-rich liquid at room temperature, which is the same starting point as a jug of raw milk, and in a tropical kitchen it will sour within hours. Carry it home cold from the market, and once it is out of the fridge follow the 2-hour rule — 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Do not leave a jug on the counter while you cook the rest of the meal.
en.fridge: Get it to 4 °C (40 °F) or below straight from the press and use it within 1–2 days. We have deliberately set that shorter than the published figure for canned coconut cream after opening: the tin has been retorted, and a fresh press has had no heat treatment at all, so it is our own conservative judgement rather than a published number. It separates into a thick cap and a thin liquid in the fridge, which is normal — stir it back. Sourness, fizzing or a sharp yeasty smell means it has gone.
en.freezer: Freezing is the right answer for anything you cannot use at once: about 3 months at −18 °C (0 °F), which is the published figure for coconut cream and carries over directly. Freeze it in an ice-cube tray or a flat bag so you can break off what you need. The emulsion splits on thawing and looks curdled — whisk or blend it back together, and use it in curries and cooked dishes rather than in a raw dressing.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge or straight into a hot pan; never on the counter. Whisk or blend the thawed cream to bring the emulsion back before using it.
spoilage: A sour or fermented smell, or a yeasty fizz when you stir it.
Gas bubbles or a lid that has lifted on a sealed container.
A slimy, ropy or stringy texture.
Grey or pink discolouration, or mould at the surface.
tips: Buy it on the morning you are cooking; freshness is the whole point.
Freeze the first press in cubes and keep the thin second press for stock.
Use a clean dry ladle, never the spoon you have been tasting with.
In hot weather take a cool bag to the market for it.

faq.q: How long does fresh coconut cream last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 1–2 days at 4 °C or below. That is deliberately shorter than the figure for opened canned coconut cream, because a fresh press has had no heat treatment.

faq.q: Can you freeze fresh coconut cream?
faq.a: Yes, for about 3 months at −18 °C. It splits on thawing, so whisk or blend it back and use it in cooked dishes.

faq.q: Why has my coconut cream separated in the fridge?
faq.a: The fat rises into a thick cap and the watery part sinks. That is normal for a fresh press — stir it back in.

faq.q: Is fresh coconut cream the same as the canned kind?
faq.a: No. Canned cream has been heat-treated in the tin and keeps far longer once opened. A fresh press is raw and behaves like raw milk.

zh.name: 新鮮椰漿
zh.summary: 現榨椰漿是椰肉刨絲後加少量水擠壓而成的生鮮乳化液，沒有經過殺菌，性質上比較接近生乳，而不是罐頭椰漿。買回來要立刻冷藏並在 1～2 天內用完，或冷凍約 3 個月。
zh.pantry: 它不能放室溫。剛榨出來的椰漿是低酸、又有蛋白質又有油脂的液體，起跑點和一壺生乳一樣，在熱帶廚房裡幾個小時就會發酸。從市場帶回家要全程保冷，離開冰箱之後請守 2 小時原則（廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時）。不要一邊煮其他菜、一邊讓椰漿擱在流理臺上。
zh.fridge: 從攤子買回來就直接放到 4 °C 以下，並在 1～2 天內用完。我們刻意把這個數字訂得比「罐頭椰漿開封後」的公告值更短：罐頭經過高溫殺菌，現榨椰漿則完全沒有任何熱處理，所以這是我們自己保守的判斷，不是公告數字。冷藏後會分成上層厚脂和下層清液，這是正常的，攪回去就好。發酸、冒泡或有尖銳的酵母味，就代表壞了。
zh.freezer: 用不完的部分，冷凍才是正解：在 −18 °C 下大約 3 個月，這是椰漿的公告值，可以直接沿用。倒進製冰盒或壓平裝袋，要用時剝一塊下來。解凍後乳化會散掉、看起來像結塊——用打蛋器或果汁機打回來，並用在咖哩等加熱料理，不要拿去做生食醬汁。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，或直接下熱鍋；不要放室溫。解凍後先打勻讓乳化回復再使用。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有發酵味，攪動時冒出酵母般的氣泡。
密封容器裡出現氣體，或蓋子被頂起來。
顏色轉灰或轉粉，或表面長霉。
tips: 要煮的當天早上再買；新鮮就是它唯一的重點。
頭道濃椰漿做成冰磚保存，二道稀的留著煮湯底。
用乾淨乾燥的杓子，不要用試過味道的湯匙。
天熱時帶保冷袋去市場裝。

faq.q: 現榨椰漿放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下大約 1～2 天。這刻意比罐頭椰漿開封後的數字更短，因為現榨的完全沒有經過熱處理。
可以，−18 °C 下約 3 個月。解凍後會分離，打勻後用在加熱料理即可。

faq.q: 椰漿冰過分層是壞掉嗎？
faq.a: 不是。油脂浮到上層、水分沉在下層，現榨椰漿本來就會這樣，攪回去就好。

faq.q: 現榨椰漿和罐頭椰漿一樣嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。罐頭在罐內經過高溫殺菌，開封後可以放比較久。現榨的是生的，要當生乳看待。
